dialog: This is a path for gods/ and I'll have you vacate it.
Let's begin/ then/ shall we?
You are unfortunate indeed to stand before me.
Show me your skills.
I'll start with you first.
Even at that distance/ you are within striking range.
Regret your decision to oppose me!
Let us now trade positions.
You will not go unpunished!
Attack me/ and I will show no mercy.
A good offense is the greatest defense.
Hesitation will cost you your life!
I shall show you divine power.
I will show you my divine power.
Bend the knee before my might.
I expect nothing good will come of drawing this out.
This is where the true battle begins!
At this stage/ I must but wield my full power.
You have managed to incur my wrath!
Underestimate a god's pride at your own peril!
Know the power of the onbashira!
I have you now!
Withstand this!
Take this!
I will shoot you out of the sky!
You shall fall/ insect!
Behold/ a god's authority!
Did you think you could escape?
These are the onbashira of the divine festival.
Four powers come together...
...to create a fourfold barrier!
Lay your eyes upon the onbashira's dance!
Link/ my onbashira!
Rain down upon the lands/ whittling it to bedrock!
I shall deploy a barrier.
The onbashiras are linked...
Withstand this!
I suppose I'll borrow your strength.
What was that? I didn't hear you.
Same as always. Do it.
You're so darn vague about everything...
Anyway/ I guess I know what you mean!
I'll make an exception to assist you.
What? Nobody asked for your help.
I'll hold them down with ivy.
Hey! Quit it already!
Why don't you ever listen/ Kanako?!
Don't tell me you forgot what happened back then.
Of course not.
I caused the wisteria vines to grow...
...and I sliced 'em down with my iron rings!
Which means I won!
Wait. That one's mine.
Hey/ lay off!
I told you to go somewhere else!
Oh/ come on!
Taste the raging soul of a god!
I am the god who presides over the spirit mountain's faith...
As I created the heavens/ so too do I rule over them.
And now you shall see...
...the power of Yasaka the Wind God!
My divine power shall subjugate this mountain.
The tempest comes/ the heavens quake...
Thunder claps/ the lands split open...
And then—all is quelled.
All in the name of Yasaka the Wind God.
I will show you my divine virtues.
The heavens and earth follow my hand.
To those who seek me out/ I bestow the might of Heaven.
Bow down!
For I am Kanako Yasaka/ the Wind God!
The first to run out of patience will lose.
Know that there will be no second chances.
I am feeling magnanimous today.
Not the position I want to be in...
The sheer impudence...
Did that not reach?
Aiding a god? A praiseworthy act.
I'd like to finish you off here.
Do not worry. I shall defeat that one.
Do not let your offensive wane.
Leave this to me. It is the right choice.
I will show you my true power.
Hold. I am not playing games/ here.
Enough! It's my turn!
Very well. I shall be your opponent.
Come/ now. You need only be thankful.
Withdraw. I shall show them my divine virtue.
Receive of the wind's guidance!
Good. Now follow me!
Time for some promotion!
Do not let victory slip from our grasp!
Follow me. We're after that one!
We're going in together!
Leave this to me. It is the right choice.
If we win here/ our faith will skyrocket!
Under my divine protection/ victory will be ours!
Show them the form of our faith!
You've done your job excellently/ Momiji...
Excellent work finding the enemy/ Momiji.
Momiji/ I shall defeat that one.
You may leave the rest to me/ Momiji.
You/ too/ are a protector of my divine virtues/ Momiji.
I will be behind you/ Momiji.
Let me handle this/ Momiji.
Momiji/ receive of the wind's guidance!
Momiji/ follow me!
Momiji/ do not let victory slip from our grasp!
You're within range now/ Momiji.
You see well/ Momiji.
Momiji/ we're charging forward.
I'll convert your faith into power/ Momiji!
Momiji/ we will obtain victory together!
With Momiji/ I will show you the form of our faith!
Aya/ you risked your life—and I will see that honored!
Excellent work finding the enemy/ Aya.
You may leave the rest to me/ Aya.
I will lend you my strength/ Aya.
I know you're much faster than that.
I will be behind you/ Aya.
You're being too careless/ Aya.
Aya/ follow me!
With me/ Aya!
Aya/ do not let victory slip from our grasp!
Show me how fast you can really go/ Aya!
I will go on the attack. If you want material/ now is your chance.
I look forward to seeing the speed of a crow tengu.
Aya/ receive of the wind's guidance!
I'll convert your faith into power/ Aya!
Aya/ we will obtain victory together!
With Aya/ I will show you the form of our faith!
Hatate/ you risked your life—and I will see that honored!

I will lend you my strength/ Hatate.

Hatate/ we will obtain victory together!
With Hatate/ I will show you the form of our faith!
Who ordered you to do something like that?!
I'll lend you a hand/ Sanae.
You may leave the rest to me/ Sanae.
You lacked that last push/ Sanae.
You haven't let your attention wander/ have you/ Sanae?
I won't let you hurt Sanae!
Going after Sanae? You have some nerve.
You won't lay a hand on Sanae!
Keep your wits about you/ Sanae.
You won't lay a finger on our Sanae!
Let us show them the power of gods and shrine maidens!
Sanae/ I will go with you!
Sanae/ follow me!
Sanae/ receive of the wind's guidance!
With me/ Sanae!
I will convert the faith we've collected into power!
Sanae/ we will obtain victory together!
With Sanae/ I will show you the form of our faith!
A difficult debt to repay/ to be sure...
Suwako/ take a few steps back/ if you would.
Suwako/ I will crush that one.
You didn't finish them? That isn't like you.
I won't let Suwako have all the glory!
Watch my back/ Suwako!
I won't let Suwako have this!
Keep an eye on the enemy/ understand?
What's this? I thought being nimble was part of your character.
Don't falter/ Suwako.
Sorry/ Suwako/ but I'm taking this one!
Follow me/ Suwako!
Suwako/ you're not getting rusty/ are you?!
I won't let Suwako have all the glory!
I'll help you with my winds/ Suwako!
You know what to do/ Suwako!
Don't show off/ Suwako.
I'll convert the faith we've accumulated into power!
Heaven and Earth are with us!
Know ye the wrath of Heaven and Earth!
Utsuho/ you risked your life—and I will see that honored...
Excellent job holding back/ Utsuho.
I will lend you my strength/ Utsuho.
You may leave the rest to me/ Utsuho.
I will be behind you/ Utsuho.
You won't lay a finger on Utsuho!
Utsuho/ you need to rein in your attention.
Utsuho/ aim for that one!
Utsuho/ receive of the wind's guidance!
I'm right by your side/ Utsuho.
Follow me/ Utsuho!
Utsuho/ with me!
Utsuho/ I grant you leave to use your full power!
Utsuho/ show them every drop of our authority!
Utsuho/ we will obtain victory together!
Letting you have your way would ruin my dignity.
I need no trickery for this attack.
I must only shut you out with my divine power.
Was that intended seriously?
An incompetent attack.
You haven't the right to fight me.
Struggle and flounder for me.
Such attacks will not affect me.
This does not bode well...
To... To trouble a god like me so...
Running from a battle before it ends? A god cannot do such a thing.
Yes... You are powerful indeed.
We must not lose! We cannot!
To fear not even the gods... I trust you're prepared for the consequences.
Your pluck/ at least/ warrants praise.
What an unpleasant attack...
This is turning into a slight issue.
Does their power rival my own?
Ugh! How did they wound me?!
It seems you're worthy of fighting me.
They're all focusing on me...
Ugh. They scored a direct hit on me...
Oh? I believe I felt something in my hand just now.
The sin of damaging onbashira is a grave one indeed.
A simple strike to parry.
You can use onbashira like this/ too.
You are insolent indeed to raise your hand against a god.
You will need more than spirit to bring me down.
You seem stronger than anticipated...
Isn't this getting exciting?
You aren't bad.
My divine power still has more to show.
I mislike being chased.
I was a step ahead.
Simple attacks are simple to avoid.
You had no intention to hit with that!
I can read your movements like a book.
Oh. Is that all?
Such attacks will not penetrate my barrier!
Is that all? How absurd.
You won't even be able to lay a hand on me.
Witness my divine virtue.
Effortless.
I will not be outshone in battle.
This will not go as easily as you think.
Do you even know who I am?
Surely they could not be this strong...
Has my divine power been made to yield?
Unforgivable... When next we meet/ you shall taste divine punishment!
Though you are my enemy/ you've done brilliantly. I yield this arena to the rest of you.
The rest is in your hands. Be quick about it.
It seems I didn't have enough faith. Unfortunately/ I've no choice but to withdraw.

I hope you've been taking pictures of Sanae this whole time.

Sanae/ you aren't hurt anywhere/ are you?

I shall quell your power.
I hadn't expected you to gain such power.
The strength of a raging Yatagarasu is fearsome indeed...

We have post-ceremony plans. Do this somewhere else.
No... Our bazaar! You will not be returning unharmed!
Do you truly dislike what we do that much?!
There is no forgiving you now!
I will capture you and wring the truth from your throat!
Begone/ illusion!
Are we expected to deal with fakes?!
My/ my. You certainly don't fear anything.
I never expected to be fighting this way!
How dare you subject me to such repulsiveness!
I'll have you step aside now/ Mehko!
You fail to use your power correctly!
How dare you use the power of other youkai!
